latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "financial-product-workflow", providing a comprehensive AI-driven framework for financial product management.

- Integrates 6 core workflow stages (需求分析, 产品设计, 技术评审, 开发跟进, 测试验收, 上线运营) with strategic planning and MBTI characteristics.
- Embeds self-operation (自运营) design principles to promote user-driven growth and engagement from the product design stage onward.
- Introduces the STAR+ compliance-first prompt framework to ensure consistent, structured, and compliant product outputs.
- Offers robust tool integration capabilities, supporting automation and fallback options for Jira, Confluence, prototyping, analytics, and more.
- Provides practical checklists, troubleshooting guides, and real-world usage examples to support various scenarios in financial product development and optimization.
